title: Duplicate and Overlap Detector
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats count as copies, values(location) as where by item
| where copies>1
| sort - copies
description: Finds items you own more than one of, catching accidental double-buys across a large collection.
value: In a big collection it is easy to rebuy something you forgot you had; a duplicate check saves money and shelf space.
implementation: Ingest item catalogue into `index=personal`; surface items with more than one copy.
visualization: Table of duplicated items with copy count and locations.
grandmaExplanation: It finds things you accidentally bought twice, which is easy to do in a big collection.
